from tslearn.utils import to_time_series_dataset
import numpy as np

# Create a list of variable-length time series using the preloaded 1D arrays
raw_data = [s1, s2[:20]]

# Transform into the strict 3D array structure (n_ts, max_sz, d)
X = to_time_series_dataset(raw_data)

# Verify the shape and the automatic nan padding
assert X.shape == (2, 40, 1), f"Expected shape (2, 40, 1), got {X.shape}"
assert np.isnan(X[1, 20, 0]), "Expected nan padding for the shorter series at index 20"
assert not np.isnan(X[1, 19, 0]), "Expected valid value before padding at index 19"
assert np.allclose(X[0, :, 0], s1), "Expected the first series to match the input exactly"

print(f"__CHECK__ to_time_series_dataset {X.shape}")
